*{{WiFiCert|WFA10946|06/20/2011}}
"250-542600-403" is silkscreened on the top of the board in the FCC photos. :"(C) Motorola Inc. 2010" appears to be silkscreened on the bottom. "250-542600-403 B" is silkscreened on the board in the images below.. :'''[[Aztech]]''' would seem to be the manufacturer of this revision.
"U61L220T00", "REV.0 GP", and "308.01191.015" is silkscreened on another :(production) board. '''[[Foxconn]]''' would obviously seem to be the manufacturer.
The S/N of this unit is 164325850624. The MAC is 00:26:42:95:7E:00. :It is manufactured in China. It can probably be safely assumed this device uses a BCM636x CPU. :The Chinese internets are [http://auction1.paipai.com/search/0/947588A7000000000401000019157DEB-8821.html pointing towards BCM6361].. and also :specify the Flash and RAM as 16 and 64 MB, respectively. The device is using a '''[[Spansion]]''' FL128PIF (16MB) Flash :and a '''[[Winbond]]''' W9751G6JB-25 (64MB) RAM chip.
The board has a single U.FL connector for the second integral antenna.
The power adapter included with the device is a '''Leader Electronics Inc.''' :MU18-2120150-A1 (100-240VAC ~ 50/60Hz, 0.6A -> 12VDC, 1.5A). :It is '''[[Motorola]]''' P/N 574958-001-00.
